messages:
maya (support): heads up — multiple customers opening tickets for 502/504 and timeouts hitting hosted inference in eu1 (az-b) since ~11:05 UTC. tickets: #3421, #3423. anyone oncall?
cheng (eng-oncall): i'm on. seeing gateway 5xx spike in eu1-azb — 5xx rate jumped ~0.3% -> 6% in last 10m. traces point to upstream timeouts from edge->runtime pool.
dave_sre (eng-sre): grabbing net traces. quick mtr from edge->eu1-azb shows consistent loss across provider hop (~15-20%). paste minimal output below:
```
# MTR to eu1-azb.edge
HOST: edge-01
Loss%  Snt  Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
 15.0   20   12.4  13.7  11.2  47.6  9.3  provider-as64512
 18.0   20   18.9  20.1  18.0  35.2  4.2  eu1-azb
```
netops (netops): filing with transit provider now — looks like AS64512 interface flapping / QoS queue overload at their POP. opening ticket with provider: 789123. cc @cheng @dave_sre.
maya (support): a few customers also reported auth errors (401) around same time — could retries be salt-ing token caches? any correlation?
cheng (eng-oncall): possible. repeated backend timeouts can lead to duplicate auth validations and stale cache entries. i'll temporarily tighten token cache TTL and add short jitter to retries at gateway.
lucas_pm (product): can we fail traffic to eu2 while provider remediates? we need minimal customer impact.
dave_sre (eng-sre): yes — we have region-fallback policy. rolling routing update for high-traffic tenants now. command: `deploy-bot route-config --selector region=eu1-azb --fallback eu2 --dry=false` (deploy-bot logs show in 30s). :gear:
netops (netops): provider acknowledged the ticket and says they're applying QoS changes on their POP. ETA ~40m. also we're asking for BGP path details — saw repeated withdraws for /24s.
cheng (eng-oncall): immediate mitigations I'm pushing: 1) lower gateway upstream timeout 15s -> 8s; 2) reduce keepalive 60s -> 30s; 3) add exponential backoff to retries (max 2 retries). deploying RBW-4123. this should reduce retry storm and auth churn.
maya (support): customers asking about billing — retries caused more requests. can we offer credits?
lucas_pm (product): approve up to $2k credits for impacted accounts. maya, prepare a short summary to send.
support_bot: ticket #3421 updated: escalated to engineering.
dave_sre (eng-sre): provider applied filter at their POP. packet loss dropped to <1% on our probes, 5xx rate down to ~0.4%. rolling back region-fallback for non-impacted tenants, keeping retry/backoff changes for 1hr.
netops (netops): provider closed ticket 789123. root cause: misconfigured QoS queue at provider POP causing burst drops to our edge. they will push a config fix and monitor.
maya (support): i'll notify affected customers and include credits. please prepare RCA and timeline.
cheng (eng-oncall): will own remediation PRs: add provider health checks to our edge monitoring, automated region-failover runbook, and strict retry budget at gateway. linking internal incident doc: https://redwood-internal/ops/incident/2977654321
dave_sre (eng-sre): action items: (a) postmortem with timeline + impact matrix; (b) add synthetic checks for AS64512 path; (c) add runbook step to throttle upstream retries on inter-region loss. i'll draft postmortem.
lucas_pm (product): thanks all. small follow-ups: customer communication draft and billing summary by EOD.
maya (support): confirmed — customers notified, credits queued. closing escalation once postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
